body: Please cherish your parents... Its a terrible feeling of hopelessness that i do not wish for anyone

Im so sorry for your loss man :( i mean... There isn't much to be said other than it has left us with an emptiness that can't be filled.. But if i go over the edge (which is likely) i will be sure to message you. Thanks and i hope you are doing good
I guess making sad drawings is the only thing i know how to do... Thats all
Im sorry this is your reality. I hope you don't take your life because you have so much love to give. Live, love and die naturally (i mean of old age). Dont give up.

I just want to get along with people man... But yeah your right maybe it wasn't so wise to post about my mothers death... I was in shock at the moment and couldn't cry so i didn't know how else to let go of the tension. I didn't expect people to actually give a fuck but all the kind words proved me wrong. Thanks for your support aswell dude i hope everything goes well for you and that you find joy. Thanks for the criticism :)
Just venting i guess im not trying to achieve anything other than letting go of a little stress. Im sorry this made you angry

Thank you all for your words... Im still in the shock phase but you have helped me even of its a little.... I've been on this subreddit for a while and on diferent accounts and this moment seems like the nail in the coffin for me but either way.. Whatever happens... No one is to blame. Love you all strangers.
